headline: CFM is separating its infrastructure from freight and passenger transport. Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Bolea announces when the reform will be completed
summary: Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Bolea said the reform separating infrastructure from freight and passenger transport at state railway CFM will be completed by 31 December 2026.
why: State rail reforms affect transport costs, public finances and the efficiency of freight logistics in the economy.
